# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.0 Worker 2 Slot 85: Late 4D Hegemons 0-Override Deepening & Anti-Hegemon Tension Cache (oe_heg2_, 0 vanilla/GUI overrides). Generated by gen_late_hegemons.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# 1. Demand Frontier Disarmament (强令邻国签署限武协议 — Military Hegemon)
oe_heg2_ci_demand_disarmament = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_HOSTILE_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = yes
	ai_tick = daily
	ai_tick_frequency = 365
	use_in_automation = no

	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		oe_heg2_can_use_mil_tools = yes
		at_war = no
	}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			oe_heg2_can_use_mil_tools = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			at_war = no
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_heg2_ci_disarmament_cd
		years = 10
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_military }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_great_power = no
			is_subject = no
			NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:actor } }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_heg2_disarmament_imposed_mod }
			scope:actor = { is_neighbor_of = prev }
		}
		enabled = {
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:recipient = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_disarmament_imposed_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_heg2_op_imposed_disarmament }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				add_prestige = 5
				oe_heg2_add_tension = { amount = 3 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_heg2_ci_demand_disarmament_tt
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:actor }
			scope:actor = {
				add_prestige = -10
				add_casus_belli = {
					target = scope:recipient
					type = casus_belli:cb_following_through_on_threat
					years = 5
				}
				oe_heg2_add_tension = { amount = 4 }
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_prestige = 5
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_heg2_op_hegemonic_fear }
			}
		}
	}

	accept = {
		add = hegemon_demand_base_acceptance
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				exists = scope:actor
				scope:actor = {
					regular_army_size >= {
						value = scope:recipient.regular_army_size
						multiply = 2.0
					}
				}
			}
			add = 35
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -80
		add = hegemon_demand_base_will_do
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:actor = {
					OR = {
						is_rival_of = scope:recipient
						opinion = { target = scope:recipient value < -25 }
					}
				}
			}
			add = 70
		}
	}
}

# 2. Enforce High-Seas Search & Escort Dues (强征公海临检与海峡护航税 — Naval Hegemon)
oe_heg2_ci_maritime_search_right = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_ECONOMY_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = no
	ai_tick = daily
	ai_tick_frequency = 365
	use_in_automation = no

	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		oe_heg2_can_use_nav_tools = yes
	}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			oe_heg2_can_use_nav_tools = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			has_ports = yes
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_heg2_ci_maritime_search_cd
		years = 10
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_trade }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_great_power = no
			has_ports = yes
			NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:actor }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_heg2_maritime_search_tribute_mod }
			scope:actor = { within_diplomatic_range = prev }
		}
		enabled = {
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:recipient = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_maritime_search_tribute_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_heg2_op_maritime_search }
				if = {
					limit = { gold >= 60 }
					add_gold = -60
				}
			}
			scope:actor = {
				add_gold = 60
				add_navy_tradition = 3
				oe_heg2_add_tension = { amount = 3 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_heg2_ci_maritime_search_right_tt
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:actor }
			scope:actor = {
				add_prestige = -8
				add_casus_belli = {
					target = scope:recipient
					type = casus_belli:cb_trade_war_triggered
					years = 5
				}
				oe_heg2_add_tension = { amount = 4 }
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_prestige = 5
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_heg2_op_maritime_search }
				add_casus_belli = {
					target = scope:actor
					type = casus_belli:oe_heg2_cb_free_seas_charter
					years = 5
				}
			}
		}
	}

	accept = {
		add = hegemon_demand_base_acceptance
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				exists = scope:actor
				scope:actor = {
					navy_size >= {
						value = scope:recipient.navy_size
						multiply = 2.0
					}
				}
			}
			add = 35
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -80
		add = hegemon_demand_base_will_do
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:recipient = {
					num_of_ports >= 4
					NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:actor } }
				}
			}
			add = 65
		}
	}
}

# 3. Sovereign Credit & Tariff Leverage (主权债信金融施压 — Economic Hegemon)
oe_heg2_ci_sovereign_credit_leverage = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_ECONOMY_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = yes
	ai_tick = daily
	ai_tick_frequency = 365
	use_in_automation = no

	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		oe_heg2_can_use_eco_tools = yes
		at_war = no
	}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			oe_heg2_can_use_eco_tools = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			at_war = no
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_heg2_ci_credit_leverage_cd
		years = 10
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_loan }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			is_rebel_country = no
			is_great_power = no
			NOT = { is_subject_of = scope:actor }
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_heg2_credit_concession_mod }
			scope:actor = { within_diplomatic_range = prev }
		}
		enabled = {
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
			OR = {
				num_loans >= 1
				monthly_income_trade_and_tax < scope:actor.monthly_income_trade_and_tax
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:recipient = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_credit_concession_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_heg2_op_credit_leverage }
			}
			scope:actor = {
				add_gold = 75
				add_prestige = 4
				oe_heg2_add_tension = { amount = 3 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_heg2_ci_sovereign_credit_leverage_tt
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:actor }
			scope:actor = {
				add_prestige = -8
				add_casus_belli = {
					target = scope:recipient
					type = casus_belli:cb_trade_war_triggered
					years = 5
				}
				oe_heg2_add_tension = { amount = 3 }
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_prestige = 4
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_heg2_op_credit_leverage }
			}
		}
	}

	accept = {
		add = hegemon_demand_base_acceptance
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:recipient = { num_loans >= 1 }
			}
			add = 45
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -75
		add = hegemon_demand_base_will_do
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:recipient = {
					num_loans >= 1
					NOT = { is_allied_with = { target = scope:actor } }
				}
			}
			add = 80
		}
	}
}

# 4. Court Etiquette & Academic Protectorate Charter (宫廷礼法与学术保护国宪章 — Cultural Hegemon)
oe_heg2_ci_cultural_client_charter = {
	type = diplomacy
	category = CATEGORY_INFLUENCE_ACTIONS
	block_when_at_war = yes
	ai_tick = daily
	ai_tick_frequency = 365
	use_in_automation = no

	ai_prerequisite = {
		is_rebel_country = no
		oe_heg2_can_use_cul_tools = yes
		at_war = no
	}

	potential = {
		scope:actor = {
			is_rebel_country = no
			oe_heg2_can_use_cul_tools = yes
		}
	}

	allow = {
		scope:actor = {
			at_war = no
		}
	}

	cooldown = {
		type = oe_heg2_ci_cultural_charter_cd
		years = 10
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		default_sort = will
		column = { data = country_diplomacy_info_influence }
		visible = {
			NOT = { this = scope:actor }
			country_exists = this
			is_rebel_country = no
			NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_heg2_cultural_client_mod }
			OR = {
				is_subject_of = scope:actor
				is_great_power = no
			}
			scope:actor = { within_diplomatic_range = prev }
		}
		enabled = {
			NOT = { is_at_war_with = scope:actor }
		}
	}

	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient }
			scope:recipient = {
				add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_heg2_cultural_client_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_heg2_op_cultural_charter }
				if = {
					limit = { is_subject_of = scope:actor }
					add_liberty_desire = -15
				}
			}
			scope:actor = {
				add_prestige = 6
				culture = {
					add_cultural_influence = 10
				}
				oe_heg2_add_tension = { amount = 2 }
			}
		}
		else = {
			custom_tooltip = oe_heg2_ci_cultural_client_charter_tt
		}
	}

	reject_effect = {
		if = {
			limit = { exists = scope:recipient exists = scope:actor }
			scope:actor = {
				add_prestige = -6
				oe_heg2_add_tension = { amount = 2 }
			}
			scope:recipient = {
				add_prestige = 5
				add_opinion = { target = scope:actor modifier = oe_heg2_op_cultural_resentment }
			}
		}
	}

	accept = {
		add = hegemon_demand_base_acceptance
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				exists = scope:actor
				scope:recipient = { is_subject_of = scope:actor }
			}
			add = 75
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				exists = scope:actor
				scope:recipient = { opinion = { target = scope:actor value >= 50 } }
			}
			add = 45
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		add = -50
		if = {
			limit = {
				exists = scope:recipient
				scope:recipient = { is_subject_of = scope:actor }
			}
			add = 90
		}
	}
}
